description:
Title: DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen

A nifty online tool helps you with repairing your Smartphone on your own.
You start by entering the model and what is broken.
The tool gives you the list of materials, the list of tools, and (for each part) several ordering choices.
Some stuff you already have (e.g. some tools, screws).
The tool also lets you contact friends if you can borrow / buy something for cheap from them.
The rest you buy.
Afterwards you receive instructions how to fix your phone.
If it worked, send a review and/or video of you fixing it.
If it hasn't worked out, you can send it to an expert.

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Owned</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotOwned</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferYes</bpmn:outgoing>

    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FriendNo</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Items_Merge" name="All items gathered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Owned</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S9</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Result_Split" name="Repair successful?" default="Flow_RepairFailed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairOk</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RepairFailed</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Feedback_Split" name="Send review and/or video">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RepairOk</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToVideo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:inclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send review" messageRef="Msg_Review">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_S11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send phone to expert" messageRef="Msg_PhoneToExpert">

      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_S14</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendYes" name="yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Friend_Split" targetRef="Task_ContactFriend"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FriendNo" name="no" sourceRef="Gateway_Friend_Split" targetRef="Task_BuyItem"/>
